notes: Background: real-time personalization for payments UX, also using LLMs for merchant message generation and fraud reranking.
Primary constraints: sub-120ms 95th-pct across north-american users; p50 target <40ms. Throughput ~200 QPS average, bursts to 1k QPS.
Cost sensitivity: unit-token cost must be < $0.0008 for whole pipeline; exploring batching + KV cache + aggressive quantization to meet price target.
Model preferences: prefer open Llama-family variants or Redwood-verified 7B/13B quantized builds; want CPU-fallback path for non-peak windows.
Routing needs: geo-routing to NA region primarily, fallback to dedicated pool in EU for GDPR-regulated merchants.
Quoted from CTO (1/13): 'We need consistent 95th latency across bursts — occasional spikes kill conversion.'

Perf ask: Redwood to run benchmark matrix vs seq-len {64,256,512}, batch sizes {1,4,8,16}, with/without prefix KV cache + int8 and int4 quant profiles. Include tail-latency (p95/p99) and cost per 1M tokens.
POC notes: initial opt rules (auto-batching + KV cache) reduced token spend ~30% on sample traces; need full workload run for representative median/95th.
Security: must pass SOC2 checklist + SSO/SAML integration; require audit-logging and option to encrypt KV cache with customer-managed KMS.
Integration: FlashSynch uses internal event bus, expects gRPC + REST API for inference. Wants consistent SDK parity with hosted and dedicated.
Next-step reminder: finalize perf matrix, schedule 48-hour 'real traffic' run, produce cost/latency tradeoff doc for procurement.
